title: LLM Serving
about: Systems for serving large language models: request scheduling and SLOs, KV-cache and in-context caching, speculative decoding, disaggregated prefill/decode, and RAG / compound-AI serving.

title: RAG
about: Retrieval-augmented generation: retrievers and indexes for LLMs, RAG pipelines, GraphRAG, agentic and multimodal RAG, evaluation, robustness and security.

title: Agent CDN
about: Content-delivery and network infrastructure for LLMs and AI agents: KV-cache and knowledge delivery networks, edge, in-network and semantic caching, web caches for agent and crawler traffic, and the agentic web.

title: Backdoor Learning
about: Backdoor (trojan) attacks on machine-learning models and defenses against them, including federated and LLM settings.

title: Machine Unlearning
about: Removing the influence of specific data from trained models: exact and approximate unlearning, evaluation and LLM unlearning.

title: Federated Learning
about: Training models across many clients without sharing raw data: optimization, heterogeneity, privacy, robustness and systems.
